set.name: Monsters Attack!
set.theme: Saturday-morning superhero and monster-movie setting: Mecha:PRIME, Star Guardian, Anima Squad, LaserCorps, Underground, Supers, Threats (kaiju monsters), Civilians, A.D.M.I.N., Gadgeteens, Ox Force.

notes.itemScope: Item and augment membership comes from the "TFTSet8" item/augment lists in the patch 13.11 CDragon file. Values come from the patch 13.5 file when the item exists there, else from 13.11. The list is the full pool the game data allows for the set mode, so it includes items obtainable only through augments, anvils or special rounds.
notes.abilityValues: Computed with 100 AP and no items; star order 1/2/3. Unresolved placeholders listed per ability.
notes.augmentTiers: Inferred from icon art suffix or apiName; approximate.

mechanics: Hero Augments: every champion has two (one carry, one support). Offered at one of the three augment rounds (2-1, 3-2, 4-2) to all players at the same cost bucket, semi-tailored to your board. 5% of games have none. 118 at launch. [12.23 notes]

Item Anvils: component anvil at 4-7 (pick 1 of 3 components); completed-item anvils at 5-7 and 6-7 (pick 1 of 5). PvE bosses from 5-7 (Aurelion Sol, Urgot, Zac) drop completed anvils, sometimes Tome of Traits or Enhanced (Ornn) anvils. [12.23 notes]
A.D.M.I.N. trait: player programs combat triggers and effects (cause + effect pairs). [CDragon]
Threat trait: monster units with no shared synergy that are strong for their cost and gain stats per Threat. [CDragon]
Over 100 returning augments plus 63 Heart, Crown, Crest and Soul augments for the new traits. [12.23 notes]
systemChanges: Physical spells work like magic spells: cannot be dodged and cannot crit without Jeweled Gauntlet-style effects. Crit chance over 100% converts to crit damage at 2:1. [12.23 notes]
Grievous Wounds 50% to 30%. AD bonuses changed from flat to percent of base AD. Item power lowered, champion base power raised. [12.23 notes]
Keywords standardized: Burn, Chill, Disarm, Mana Reave, Omnivamp, Shred, Stun, Sunder, Taunt, Wound. [12.23 notes]
